subject: System Design
title: Data Duplication
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Data Duplication.

hook.text: The order service needs the customer's name. Should it call the customer service every time? That's slow.

buildup.text: Data duplication stores a copy of needed data locally. The order service keeps a copy of the customer name.

discovery.text: This eliminates cross-service calls for reads. The order service reads from its own database — fast and decoupled.

twist.text: The customer name changes. Now the order service has stale data. Events propagate the change, but there's a delay.

climax.text: Data duplication trades storage and freshness for independence and speed. Embrace it in microservices.

punchline.text: Copy what you need — accept eventual consistency.

quiz.question: Why duplicate data across microservices?
options: To avoid cross-service calls and improve read performance
